entry.title: Resolution 550 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS OF COST ITEMS ASSOCIATED WITH THE HAWAIʻI FIRE FIGHTERS ASSOCIATION, BARGAINING UNIT 11, AND CERTAIN OTHER EMPLOYEES EXCLUDED FROM BARGAINING UNIT 11 FOR THE CONTRACT PERIOD BEGINNING JULY 1, 2025, AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2029

The estimated costs over the four years of the new contract resulting from across-the-board increases would be $25,292,860.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 550-26 & FC-149 - 05/20/26
